column7: Decides whether a task-store mutation runs now, parks or is refused ("restarting") while a restart checkpoint holds the store; the one admission every mutation passes
Decides whether an expiry sweep tick may start while the store is paused, draining or terminal
Builds the store's gate open, with the receiver it keeps for its lifetime; a wrong start state would let writes through a checkpoint
Records a storage failure of admitted work during an attempt, which fails that attempt's checkpoint
Closes the gate for an attempt and stores its deadline and backstop, the bounds every park uses
Moves the gate to certified after the attempt's checkpoint; parks stay parked
Cancel recovery: drains parked submitters before newer arrivals, then opens the gate
A stop signal won: admits parked work and everything after it, no ordering
The commit edge: refuses new external submissions, admits work parked before it and internal completion work
Admits each task-store mutation through TaskGate::admit before its blocking work is spawned, and moves the admission into that work so it stays counted; a refusal returns before anything runs
Marks a storage error from admitted work as a failure, which fails the attempt's checkpoint
The gate's one decision: admits, parks or refuses a task-store mutation for the state, the caller's class and its ticket; TaskGate::admit acts on it
Sets when a parked submitter decides again on its own: one second past its attempt's deadline (external), its backstop (internal), never while draining
Marks the open attempt failed when admitted work failed or ended without an outcome; the checkpoint refuses on it
Counts one drain member done and opens the gate at zero, so newer writes wait for the cohort
Gives a ticket parked in an earlier attempt the current attempt's bounds, so a stale deadline cannot refuse it
Ends an admission: uncounts it, fails the attempt when the work reported no outcome, and counts a cohort member done
Ends a parked submitter's ticket; one of a drain's cohort that ends unadmitted still counts done
